title: Astrid and the Bell
author: Ines Nakamura
blurb: Oscar Joubert, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
